definitions.gloss: city center, downtown, heart of the city
definitions.explanation: The central area of a city, particularly a major metropolitan area. Often refers specifically to central Tokyo.

examples.japanese: {都心|としん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: Apartments in the city center are expensive.

examples.japanese: {都心|としん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{郊外|こうがい}→郊外：01403_kougai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}した→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧。
examples.english: I moved from downtown to the suburbs.

examples.japanese: {都心|としん}⟦{回帰|かいき}→回帰：12061_kaiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}られる→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: A trend of returning to the city center can be seen.
examples.notes: {都心|としん}⟦{回帰|かいき}→回帰：12061_kaiki⟧ = return to city center living

notes:
USAGE: {都心|としん} is commonly used to refer to the central area of Tokyo, but can apply to other major cities as well.

TOKYO SPECIFIC:
- {都心|としん}3⟦{区|く}→区：01997_ku⟧ - Chiyoda, Chuo, Minato (the three central wards)
- ⟦{副|ふく}→副：03965_fuku⟧{都心|としん} - sub-centers like Shinjuku, Shibuya, Ikebukuro

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {都心|としん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{地価|ちか}→地価：12130_chika⟧ (city center land prices)
- {都心|としん}⟦{回帰|かいき}→回帰：12061_kaiki⟧ (return to city center)
- {都心|としん}⟦{部|ぶ}→部：00440_bu⟧ (central urban area)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {都心|としん} (city center)
- ⟦{郊外|こうがい}→郊外：01403_kougai⟧ (suburbs)
- ⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧ (rural areas/provinces)
